user.title: Give your Spooky light ears
user.description: Pick the light you paired with **ZHA** (Zigbee Home Automation) — a XIAO Spooky Sound (SpookyLab XIAO-C6-SpookySound) or a NanoC6 Spooky Lights. {found} unconfigured SpookyLab light(s) found in ZHA; if there's exactly one it's already selected. Its entities are mapped automatically on the next step. Zigbee2MQTT is supported on a best-effort basis; leave the field empty to map entities by hand.

entities.title: Which entity does what?
entities.description: {found} entities were recognised automatically. A NanoC6 Spooky Lights has no microphone: just map its Effect to let it follow the soundtrack. The raw ZHA Sound cue, Sound source and Sound event entities are hidden once Spooky Sound takes over (removing Spooky Sound shows them again).

music.title: The soundtrack
music.description: All optional — you can change these later under Configure.

data.sendspin: Sync to the music with Sendspin (Music Assistant visualizer)
data.sendspin_host: Music Assistant host (leave empty to use the Music Assistant integration's)

data_description.media_player: Pick the Music Assistant player for your Halloween speaker. When its track sounds like a storm, a fire, a heartbeat, a cauldron or a haunting, the light switches to the matching effect, and back when it stops.
data_description.sendspin: Needs the speaker to be a Sendspin player in Music Assistant (e.g. the SendspinDroid app). Installs the aiosendspin library when first enabled.
data_description.sendspin_host: e.g. 192.168.1.10 or mass.local. The Sendspin port (8927) is added for you.
data_description.lead_ms: How early to send each cue so the flash lands on the sound: the delay from Home Assistant to the light over Zigbee.

error.nothing_mapped: Map at least the effect, the sound cue, the sound source or the sound event.

music.title: The soundtrack
music.description: Keywords are matched as whole words in the track's title, artist and album, in this order (storms win over fires). Separate them with commas.

send_cue.name: Send sound cue
send_cue.description: Make the light react as if it had heard something: a thunderclap, a burst of crackles, a heartbeat… Handy for doorbell jump scares.

device_id.name: Light
device_id.description: Which Spooky Sound light(s). Leave empty for all of them.

cue.description: What the light should react to.

strength.name: Strength
strength.description: How hard (0–1). For fire and rumble, the level.

count.name: Count
count.description: For crackles: how many, spread over about 0.4 s.
